He calleth his own sheep by name.
By God's grace, our church is growing. And as the Lord adds to our number, our care must keep up.
At the door, a simple touch, and each person is greeted by name, and checked in. No lines. No logbooks. Our ushers are free to welcome people.
Every touch is recorded right away, so we know who is with us, even before the first hymn is sung.
Flock also shows the state of the flock, welcomes first-time visitors, keeps our church roll in the Bible's order, and reminds us whose birthdays to pray for, every Lord's Day,
so the pastor and workers can visit those we missed.
